name: Eurocodes with the UK National Annexes
edition: BS EN 1990-1998 with the UK National Annexes
description: The Eurocodes with the UK National Annexes (alpha 9 track C15): only the Nationally Determined Parameters, everything else from the base pack Eurocodes (recommended values). BS EN 1990 Eqs 6.10a/b with ξ 0.925 and the UK ψ (wind 0.5); BS EN 1991-1-1 imposed loads of Tables NA.2-NA.4 and roofs 0.6 kN/m²; BS EN 1991-1-4 vb,map of Figure NA.1 by town with the altitude factor calt = 1 + 0.001 A; BS EN 1991-1-3 sk by the zone of Figure NA.1 and the site altitude; BS EN 1992-1-1 αcc 0.85 (flexure and axial) and 1.0 (shear), Δcdev 10 mm; BS EN 1993-1-1/-1-8 γM0 1.0, γM1 1.0, γM2 1.10 (members) and 1.25 (joints); BS EN 1997-1 Design Approach 1; BS EN 1998-1: very low seismicity (no seismic design by default); bar schedules by BS 8666. Every value is listed in VERIFY.md for checking against the printed annexes.
